Oneliner

Two CubeSat missions housing a range of experiments pre-selected by the European Commission.
Description

Deimos will be in charge of overseeing the implementation of the IOD-IOV projects, which includes the delivery of two CubeSat missions housing a range of experiments pre-selected by the European Commission. These CubeSats are scheduled for launch in 2025 and will play a pivotal role in pushing the boundaries of space technology.
